title: A Space's Circle page shows one photo (the Space header) and renders as an ordinary member page beside that header, not inside the Space page's styling

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 (localhost /circles/wildheart-primary-circle): I am not entirely sure what you are going for here; the header image shows three times, a gap, serif cards, a beige lower page and overlapping labels.

detail: SCAN-881 put a Space Circle's whole page inside FqSpaceChrome's body (.fqs-pane[data-space-page]) and the Space's AccentScope font set, so the Circle took space-page.css's dress (serif type, a beige ground, re-sized labels) and its own photo hero stacked under the Space cover. FqCircleSpaceHeader now renders the Space header with an empty body and the Circle page beside it, outside the Space page scope; and under a Space header the Circle's band is a plain kit card (no photo, dark type, h2 size) so the page has one photo.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/space/circle-space-header.tsx','utf8'),c=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/circle/circle-shell.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/<\/FqSpaceChrome>[\s\S]{0,600}\{children\}/.test(h))bad.push('the Circle still renders inside the Space page body');if(!c.includes('fqm-cl-hero is-plain'))bad.push('the Circle band still stacks a second photo under the Space header');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-900: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
